title: Home Time
textBlocks:
Joshua tells the eastern tribes to
GO HOME

WELL DONE TRIBES FROM EAST
Joshua tells the 2 and a half tribes
WELL DONE!
He tells them that they did everything Moses asked them to do
and everything that he Joshua told them to do
and they obeys the commands of the Lord
and they helped the other tribes

JOSHUA BLESSES THEM
Then Joshua 
BLESSES them
Go home and take all the treasure you got from your enemies
The gold, silver, bronze, iron, herds of sheep, cows, goats and clothes

He also WARNS them
To be careful to obey the Lord’s commands
and to serve Him with all their hearts and souls

BLESS YOUR CHILD
Mom and Dad, when you say bedtime prayers
Say this blessing over your child

“May the Lord bless you
and protect you
May the Lord smile on you
and be gracious to you
May the Lord show you His favor 
and give you His peace”

NUMBERS 6.24-26

CRAFT TIME
Make a star chart for when you LISTEN and OBEY your mom and dad
